evals.expected_output: Fetches the account with list_provider_accounts, deletes collaborators and every integration's authorized_subjects from the fetched manifest, keeps every existing integration, appends the new model, validates and applies once; does not re-send the stored collaborators list.
expectations: The applied manifest has no collaborators field
No integration carries authorized_subjects
Every existing integration is still present
Does not write collaborators to change access

evals.prompt: Give team:data-science access to the openai-main provider account.
evals.expected_output: Finds the account's id/fqn with list_provider_accounts and the team's id with list_teams_for_user, then calls create_grants with resourceType provider-account, the account fqn, subjectType team, the team id and roleId provider-account-access. Does not apply the provider account manifest with collaborators.
expectations: Calls create_grants (not apply_manifest with collaborators)
subjectId is the team's internal id, not its name
roleId is provider-account-access

evals.prompt: Who has access to the openai-main provider account? Remove bob@acme.com from it.
evals.expected_output: Calls list_grants with resourceType provider-account and the account id, lists subjects and roles, then revokes bob's grant with revoke_grant using the values from his list_grants row; if his row has source ROLE_BINDING, explains it comes from role binding <roleBindingName> and must be changed there.
expectations: Uses list_grants to show current access
Calls revoke_grant with the row's subjectId and roleId
Does not edit collaborators
Handles a ROLE_BINDING grant by pointing to the binding

evals.prompt: Give me a role-binding manifest so we can keep workspace access for team ml-eng in Git.
evals.expected_output: Reads access-management.md role bindings, gets the role-binding schema, and returns a role-binding YAML with subjects [{type: team, name: ml-eng}] and permissions on the workspace fqn with workspace-editor; applies only if the user asks and is a tenant admin.
expectations: Uses a role-binding (access as code), not create_grants
Gives the YAML
Does not apply without the user asking
